# P31.15 (SURFACE.2): per-compartment vector tiles, `/map` on PMTiles, repo-owned `sig-web` compression + deploy path

Implements `docs/tickets/P31.15__vector-tiles-and-compression.md`
(Round 9 Wave B, manifest row 156; `live_verification=false`). Executes the
ratified **Q8 = no basemap** and **Q9 = retire `/map/points.json`** decisions and
the engineering half of **D-P30.3-2**. Stacked on the P31.14 tip
`devin/p31-14-presentation-analytics-from-export` (PR #151). Nothing is
published or deployed by this ticket — P31.16 owns the hosted re-export,
republish, `sig-web` roll, and live verification.

## Summary

- **`exports/tiles.py` — a real tile builder, not the z0 stub.** Pure-Python
  PMTiles v3 renderer promoted to a genuine **z0–z14 pyramid**: spec-§4 Hilbert
  tile ids (tested against the spec's own table), delta-encoded multi-entry
  directory with leaf-pointer support, gzip-compressed deterministic MVT point
  tiles (same-cell dedup at low zooms, slim render properties — entity_id,
  label, jurisdiction, sensitivity_tier, precision), bounds + `vector_layers` +
  `attribution` + `sig:license` metadata (`ODbL-1.0` → OSM attribution, ADR-048).
  `render_pmtiles_file` prefers **tippecanoe `-Z0 -z14`** plus a post-hoc
  `sig:license`/attribution annotation pass and falls back to the pure-Python
  renderer for CI (`SIG_TILES_RENDERER` override). Two renders of the same
  snapshot are byte-identical (tested).
- **Tippecanoe pinned in the export image.** `ops/Dockerfile` gains a
  multi-stage builder: 2.79.0 source tarball sha256-verified
  (`b0fd9df4…f05d`) before compile, the binary COPYed into the runtime image.
  Stale `min-instances 0` header comment corrected to the API's deployed
  posture.
- **One archive per licence compartment.** Both export paths go through
  `render_compartment_sites_pmtiles` → `web/tiles/<compartment>-sites.pmtiles`
  as manifest artifacts (`--from-spine`: every public compartment; the
  `--jurisdiction` path now registers `osm_physical-sites.pmtiles` in the
  manifest before `bundle.write_to` instead of writing a stale post-hoc
  `sig-infrastructure.pmtiles`). `ops/publish.py`'s partition check already
  refuses a public-site tile absent from the public partition — no edit needed.
  Tiles render only the already-published tier-0, §19.4-reduced coordinates.
- **The island draws tiles.** `web/src/lib/data.ts` adds
  `getCompartmentTileSources()` (manifest `web/tiles/*-sites.pmtiles` →
  same-origin `/tiles/…` paths, sorted); `web/src/lib/map-tiles.ts`'s
  `buildPublicMapStyle` emits a plain-background style with one validated
  `pmtiles://` source + circle layer **per compartment**, each carrying its
  licence attribution (ODbL sources get OSM attribution) — no basemap source or
  URL anywhere (Q8). `MapIsland.tsx` registers the `pmtiles` protocol, layers
  each compartment, polls source features for `data-drawn` (the old one-shot
  `idle` raced tile loads), and keeps the fixtures-mode inline-GeoJSON
  fallback. `map.astro` keeps the static tabular equivalent + no-coordinate
  indicators — the zero-JS map is unchanged. `map/style.json.ts` emits the
  dynamic per-compartment style.
- **`/map/points.json` retired (Q9 — R8-1 ending).** The endpoint file, the
  `map.ts` payload codec, the island fetch, and the astro redirect are all
  gone; an export-mode build verifies the file is not emitted. The accepted
  combined-render-object deviation is recorded **ending** in ACCEPT-R8 — it
  closes live at P31.16's republish.
- **Repo-owned `sig-web` compression + deploy path.** `ops/web/nginx.conf`
  (gzip for JSON/CSS/HTML/SVG/PMTiles-family types + `gzip_vary`; PMTiles →
  `application/vnd.pmtiles`; byte ranges over the gcsfuse-shaped root; hashed-
  asset cache policy). `ops/web/Dockerfile` multi-stage: compiles `ngx_brotli`
  (`a71f931…` + bundled brotli `ed738e8…`) and nginx `1.27.5` modules —
  Alpine's prebuilt brotli package is ABI-mismatched with the runtime nginx,
  verified by a failed smoke — every tarball sha256-verified, dynamic modules
  COPYed onto a digest-pinned `nginx:1.27-alpine`. `ops/gcp/web.sh` is the
  first repo-owned deploy path: git-archive → Cloud Build `sig-web:<git-sha>`
  (never `:latest`) → `pin_image_digest` → `gcloud run deploy` reproducing the
  live-read
  service shape (gcsfuse mount of `${SIG_GCP_PROJECT}-sig-web`, env, ingress;
  never `:latest`). Built and probed locally (gzip + br + HTTP 206 + correct
  content type, `nginx -t` clean); **not rolled — P31.16 rolls**.
- **Docs/ledger:** ADR-118 (ADR-R9-TILES) with `## Revisit trigger` — Q8 none +
  the costed self-hosted-extract follow-up, Q9 retire, R8-1 ending; adr-index
  regenerated; Appendix F row + canonical spec rebuilt via `BUILD.sh`; BL-056
  sources + `BACKLOG.md` regenerated; DEFERRALS + ACCEPT-R8 annotated.

## Deferred obligations

- **D-P30.3-2 → stays OPEN (advanced).** The engineering half (tiles,
  compression config, repo-owned deploy path, island, `points.json` retired
  from the build) is done here; the public half — the live map drawing tiles
  and `points.json` verified gone on the hosted surface — is **P31.16's**.
- **R8-1 (ACCEPT-R8) → ENDING, not closed.** The build no longer emits the
  licence-mixed `/map/points.json` and the island no longer fetches it; the
  live object stops being served at P31.16's republish, which closes it.
- **D-P30.3-1 / D-P30.3-3 → unchanged OPEN** (public halves are P31.16-owned;
  not touched).
- No new deferral opened; none closed.

## Out of scope (honoured)

No hosted re-export, republish, `sig-web` roll, or `probe-hosted` (P31.16); no
analytics changes (P31.14); no self-hosted OSM basemap extract (recorded as a
costed follow-up in ADR-118); no third-party tile service ever; no merge/tag/
push-main.
